courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的橋梁與建築；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring bridges and buildings through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 大跨度空間桁架提升
related.transfer: 可遷移「交織平面桁架的空間門式結構」與「溫度作用與施工監測」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；大跨度空間桁架提升的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "A portalised space truss of interlaced plane trusses" and "Thermal action and construction monitoring" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Lifting of long-span space trusses must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以 24 組桁架柱支承、12 m 深交織平面桁架構成的空間門式鋼屋蓋，及其節點、臨時支撐與分級卸載；大跨度空間桁架提升則以在地面組裝大跨度鋼屋蓋後，以鋼絞線千斤頂或頂升機構整體提升，並控制吊點反力、同步誤差、塔架穩定與就位轉換為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on A portalised steel roof of interlaced 12 m deep plane trusses on 24 column trusses, its nodes, falsework and staged unloading; Lifting of long-span space trusses centres on ground-assembling long-span steel roofs and lifting them whole by strand jacks or push-up, controlling lift-point reactions, synchronisation, tower stability and final transfer, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「12 m 深主桁架網」與「地面組裝與整體提升」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到大跨度空間桁架提升，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「試提升、重量核對與變形量測」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “12 m deep primary truss grid” and “Ground assembly and integral lift”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Lifting of long-span space trusses, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Trial lift, weight check and deformation survey", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 北京國家體育場
history.text: 北京國家體育場由 Herzog & de Meuron 與中國建築設計研究院合作設計，Arup 擔任結構與機電顧問，2002 至 2003 年競圖勝出後於 2003 年 12 月 24 日奠基。原方案含可開合屋頂，2004 年 6 月因鋼材成本與預算壓力取消，屋蓋開口隨之加大、用鋼量下降；主結構為交織的 12 m 深平面桁架，以 24 組桁架柱支承，設計採三級性能化耐震與性能化防火。體育場於 2008 年完工，作為北京奧運主場館，2022 年再次用於冬奧開閉幕式。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。
history.textEn: The Beijing National Stadium was designed by Herzog & de Meuron with China Architecture Design & Research Group, with Arup as structural and building-services engineer; after winning the 2002–2003 competition the foundation stone was laid on 24 December 2003. The original scheme included a retractable roof, dropped in June 2004 because of steel costs and budget pressure, which enlarged the roof opening and reduced steel; the primary structure is a set of interlaced 12 m deep plane trusses on 24 column trusses, designed with three-level performance-based seismic design and performance-based fire engineering. Completed in 2008 as the main venue of the Beijing Olympics, it hosted the 2022 Winter Olympics ceremonies. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.
